description: This file contains utility functions for handling large file reads, token estimation, and summarization related to the Task object in a TypeScript project. It manages token limits, file content size checks, and native file parsing for a codebase involving task processing.

methods.name: allowVeryLargeReads
methods.description: Checks if the task allows very large reads based on its state.

methods.name: getTokenEstimate
methods.description: Estimates the number of tokens in a given output text for the task.

methods.name: getTokenLimit
methods.description: Calculates the token limit based on the task's model context window and a size fraction.
